name: omni_robust_bench
description: Omni Robust Bench is a community-contributed robustness evaluation suite designed to measure model performance under varied distribution shifts and perturbations. It aggregates diverse text-based perturbations and tasks to assess stability and generalization of models. The benchmark is intended to evaluate robustness rather than raw peak performance.
reputation: A community-contributed robustness benchmark with modest visibility and adoption, used primarily for stress-testing models.
